press_references.value: Origin's new low-fee AI ‘robo-planner’ (that still won’t threaten human advisors)

product_launches.description: Origin has debuted a revamped AI-powered personal finance app that bundles budgeting, investing, and financial planning tools and is marketed as an SEC-regulated AI financial advisor at $1 for the first year and $99 annually thereafter.

overview_description.description: Origin was founded on the belief that financial planning should be accessible to everyone at every stage of life. Origin is the first comprehensive employee financial wellness platform for the modern workforce. Its integrated solution helps employees manage compensation, benefits, and personal finances in a single place – side-by-side with financial professionals. Origin is the first platform that combines human financial planners with cutting-edge financial technology that both educates employees and allows them to create, execute, and track their personalized financial plans.

about_short_description.short_description: Origin is a financial planning platform that manages compensation, benefits, and personal finances for employees.

product.name: Origin Financial Planning Platform
product.description: A web and mobile financial planning platform that consolidates personal financial data and provides tools for spending analysis, investing, forecasting, and financial guidance.

product.name: Spending
product.description: A personal finance management service for connecting accounts, categorizing transactions, monitoring spending, creating budgets, and identifying or canceling subscriptions.

product.name: Investing
product.description: An investment tracking and advisory service that monitors portfolios, analyzes asset allocation and positions, and provides market and investment insights.

product.name: Forecasting
product.description: A financial scenario-planning tool that projects net worth, cash flow, and retirement readiness based on connected finances, goals, and changes in income, spending, taxes, and investments.

product.name: Financial Planning and Advisory Services
product.description: Personalized financial planning and investment advisory services delivered through Origin Investment Advisory LLC, including guidance from financial planners or the Origin AI Advisor.

product.name: Couples
product.description: A shared financial workspace that allows partners to combine or coordinate financial information, goals, spending, and forecasts within Origin.
